notes: No synthesis route in packet (n6 text-only). Two branches: electrical (Se donor -> n_H, mu_H -> rho -> PF) and thermal (single-phase alloy -> alloy scattering -> low kappa_L), meeting in RT ZT and efficiency. Audits: a1 (x=0 has the same Bi/Sb ratio yet much higher kappa_L+kappa_b, so the alloy-scattering attribution does not explain the Se-dependent drop), a2 (F5c PF for x=0.005 is ~11% below S^2/rho, so the headline RT ZT 0.84 is not reproduced from the plotted PF and kappa), s8 (DFT cell Se content ~12x experiment). Packet/figure defects: F4b mobility axis unit printed as 10^19 cm^-3; F5 linked text says rho reaches a maximum at x=0.01 while the figure shows the minimum; composition typo Mg3.2Bi1.4Sb0.595Se0.01; text Mn2O3-type (usually anti-La2O3-type); (ZT)eng ~0.9 in text vs ~0.84 in F7b.
